cross_source_reconciliation.result: Frozen-head modeld has the same empty BACKENDS architecture; later Drive delta centralizes only the modeld port through config.instanz. Core labels MODELD_BASE as legacy, while install.sh still creates, enables and starts aicore-modeld.service.

semantic_findings.finding: BACKENDS is an empty dict at module definition, so /models is empty and every /infer model_id is rejected as unknown. No config loader populates BACKENDS.
semantic_findings.inheritance: A service with zero routable backends must advertise NOT_READY/DISABLED, not run as a nominal model daemon.

semantic_findings.finding: GET /health always returns HTTP 200 with ok:true even when BACKENDS is empty and active_model is None.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Readiness must encode required capability availability. HTTP process liveness and functional readiness are distinct typed states.

semantic_findings.finding: Core marks MODELD_BASE as legacy, yet frozen install.sh creates, enables and starts aicore-modeld.service by default.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Boot manifest must be generated from active dependency graph. Dead/legacy services cannot remain mandatory-autostarted because they distort health, resource use and failure diagnosis.

semantic_findings.finding: _backend_sema is constructed once from BACKENDS keys. Even if BACKENDS were later mutated externally, semaphores would not appear automatically.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Backend registry and concurrency control must update transactionally under one runtime registry version.

semantic_findings.finding: POST reads Content-Length bytes without a configured upper bound before JSON parsing. Loopback limits exposure but does not create a resource boundary.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Internal HTTP surfaces still require bounded message envelopes and principal/effect provenance.

positive_controls: Backend access is semaphore-limited per configured backend.
Backend health and active-model state are separated in response structure.
Drive delta adopts centralized multi-instance port resolution.

frank: Do not infer model capability from service process existence.
harness: Boot/readiness tests must fail when mandatory service reports ok with zero functional backends; detect legacy autostart services.
needle: Route only to runtime-registered READY backends with immutable identity.
claycode: Model daemon state should distinguish ABSENT, CONFIGURED, LOADING, READY, DEGRADED and DISABLED.
unifieddb: Persist active service/dependency topology and supersession rather than retaining dead service identity indefinitely.
claygraph: Mark modeld as legacy/dormant lineage and connect installer autostart as contradiction edge.
gwt: Service health signals entering workspace must reflect functional readiness, not process liveness.
clay: One-module architecture should delete dead service boundaries rather than preserve them as no-op daemons.
